question.problem:
Given that the random variable $X$ has the probability density function

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{75}x,\, & 5\le x\le 10 \\ 0,\, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

its cumulative distribution function is 

$$
F(x)=\{\begin{aligned}0,\, & x<5 \\ h(x),\, & 5\le x\le 10 \\ 1,\, & x>10.\end{aligned}
$$

Find the function $h(x).$
question.worked_solution:
Since our random variable $X$ has a probability distribution function $f(x)$ that is strictly positive only for $5\le x\le 10,$ the cumulative distribution function takes the following form:

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x)=\{\begin{aligned}0, & x<5 \\ {\int }_{5}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t, & 5\le x\le 10 \\ 1, & x>10\end{aligned}
$$

For the given probability density function, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{5}^{x}f(t)\,\text{d}t & ={\int }_{5}^{x}\frac{2}{75}t\,\text{d}t \\ \text{ } & ={\frac{1}{75}{t}^{2}|}_{5}^{x} \\  & =\frac{1}{75}{x}^{2}-\frac{1}{3} \\  & =\frac{{x}^{2}-25}{75}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the cumulative distribution function is given by

$$
F(x)=\{\begin{aligned}0,\, & x<5, \\ \frac{{x}^{2}-25}{75},\, & 5\le x\le 10, \\ 1,\, & x>10.\end{aligned}
$$
